name: Stone Creek Furniture
old_description: Stone Creek Furniture is a family-owned factory and showroom in Chandler, Arizona, building custom furniture, cabinetry, and home renovations for Phoenix metro homeowners since 1990. From full kitchen renovations and custom closets to handcrafted dining tables and built-in media walls — everything is designed around your space and built by hand, right here in our factory.
about:
Stone Creek Furniture operates a family-owned factory and showroom in Chandler, Arizona, where it has been building custom furniture, cabinetry, and home renovations since 1990. The company was established as a direct manufacturing operation serving the Phoenix metropolitan area.

The shop produces a range of residential millwork including kitchen and bathroom remodels, custom closets, built-in media walls, home office furniture, bedroom sets, dining tables, bar and wine cabinetry, laundry rooms, and architectural millwork. All pieces are designed in-house and fabricated by hand at the Chandler facility, with the company also providing full installation services.

Stone Creek primarily serves homeowners throughout the Phoenix metro region, delivering turnkey projects for kitchens, bathrooms, entertainment spaces, and whole-home renovations. Clients work directly with the company's design team and ownership — including owner Ron and his sons Ryan and Justin — from concept through final installation.

The company differentiates itself by eliminating middlemen through its factory-direct model, offering an AI-powered visualization tool (Stone Creek Design AI) that lets customers see designs in their actual spaces before production, and managing every phase from design to install with its own crews.
